products.title: Thermalright Wonder Vision 360 UB ARGB LCD AIO Liquid CPU Cooler - Black / White
products.body_html:
About this item :


ROTATAVLE AND CUSTOMIZABLE 6.67'' CURVED SCREEN: Thermalright Wonder Vision 360 UB ARGB Black CPU water cooler equipped with a large 6.67'' Curved Screen 3D Anamorphic Effect, which features sharp 2400*1800 pixel resolution provides a visually stunning view in PC case. With Multiple presets system modes, user can view and customize real-time statistics, Upload and see custom pictures and animated gifs. Please download the application in thermalright official website.

ALL-IN-ONE FAN DESIGN：2150RPM TL-UB36 fans streamlines installation and lighting control—Reduce wiring clutter，no need to connect individual fans.

NEW DESIGN PUMP: Accumulating several generations of solutions and recasting new structure, give efficient heat transfer, and optimized pump design features a strong nine-pole rotor motor, new fluid impeller that rotates up to 6400RPM while staying under a quiet 27. dB(A). New design pump maximize the cooling capacity with the pre-applied thermal paste.

LIQUID LEAK PROOF: Thermalright AIO water cooling system all adopt the brand's patented anti-leak technology. The pressure relief device in the radiator can discharge the internal air pressure caused by high temperature to prevent your equipment from leaking.

COMPATIBILITY: Quick and simple installation on the latest Intel and AMD motherboard sockets Intel：LGA1851/1700/1200/115X/2011/2066, AMD：AM4/AM5. any problems, Thermalright always remains at your disposal.

products.title: Lian Li Hydroshift II LCD-S 360N White All-in-One Fanless CPU Cooler with LCD - 4718466021410
products.body_html:
The Hydroshift II LCD-S is Lian Li’s next-generation AIO liquid cooler, designed for enhanced case compatibility and a cleaner aesthetic thanks to its side-mounted tubing, creating a sleek, near-tubeless look. At its heart is a 3.4" square IPS LCD display with a crisp 480 x 480 resolution, 500 nits of brightness, and a smooth 60Hz refresh rate. This display supports three control modes — Offline, USB-connected, and Wireless — each offering versatile customisation via L-Connect 3 software. A reduced-size radiator boosts installation flexibility, while an innovative sliding tube clamp ensures precise alignment. The cooler also uses server-grade corrugated tubing for greater bendability and durability.
